protocol.refinement: Nine small neighbors of each family development winner, tested on Jan-Jun 2021 only
protocol.ranking: Priority >=10 baskets, then weakest marked quarter net, then total net, then name
protocol.acceptance: Both refinement quarters positive, >=10 refinement baskets; final >=20 baskets, net positive, PF>=1.15, DD<=10%, bootstrap lower>0, doubled-cost net>0
protocol.risk: 1:1 combined executable gross basket P&L target/stop, estimated 0.25% loss budget including friction, one basket, <=0.8x gross, daily1.5% halt; hourly monitoring can overrun stops
protocol.fees: Futures 5bps each fill, spot 10bps each fill, 4bps spread and 2bps adverse slippage each side; funding on all carried futures legs
protocol.limitations: Fixed eight surviving coins selected today, not historical universe; carry is variable perpetual funding, not locked dated-futures arbitrage
protocol.spot_gaps: No carry executions in missing spot hours; last observed price for valuation only; funding still settles; deadlines can overrun until quotes resume

bootstrap.method: IID resampling of nonoverlapping 7-day marked-equity changes; final partial week omitted, no multiple-testing correction
